name: Amber's Secret Lover - Ren'Py Release
source:
Saucy, adventurous Amber hasn't been able to shake the idea of getting with an older man. Her Husband spends way too much time at work, but she's been craving a more...experienced touch. When a sophisticated older friend comes to stay over for a few weeks, Amber finally gets a chance to explore her deepest fantasies...and gets more than she bargained for!​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/ambers-secret-44959515]Patreon[/url]]

A Ren'Py edition of the original comic.
translation:
热情大胆、爱冒险的安珀，一直无法摆脱与年长男人亲热的念头。丈夫花在工作上的时间实在太多，而她渴望的是更……有经验的触碰。当一位成熟老练的年长友人前来借住几周，安珀终于有机会探索内心最深处的幻想……结果却远远超出了她的预期！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/ambers-secret-44959515]Patreon[/url]]

原作漫画的Ren’Py改编版。
